description: Catch-all zero-result response for any record_search against Norway, Marriages, 1660-1926 (collection 1468080) whose surname is NOT the collection's abbreviated 'Halsteinsdr' -- covers the original exact spelling ('Halsteinsdatter'), a given-name-only variant paired with the still-full surname, or any other query shape that keeps the surname's letters. `response.query` echoes the first of those, since an echo can only name one concrete call. NOT a principal-only search with no surname filter: `collectionId` is not one of validateInput's anchors (surname, recordCountry, batchNumber), so a query against this collection with no surname is refused before any response exists. Models that varying the given name alone (already-fixed behavior) or restructuring the query without touching the surname's letters still fails to recover the record, forcing a deliberate surname-abbreviation attempt. Must be listed after record-search-urna-halsteinsdr-marriage-match.json in the test's mcp_fixtures array so the specific positive match is checked first.
